items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Sure, I worked with Emma a good many times.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Celestan or Emma Barrett?
I played a couple of jobs with Papa, but not to be in the band, you know, not regular, no. Did you ever work with Emma Barrett much? Emma? Sure, I worked with Emma a good many times.
I was thinking you'd work with her soon.
